verdict.rationale: Gazebo exposes a plugin architecture (gz-sim plugins, gz-transport pub/sub) that developers can use to write custom C++ code reacting to simulation events like sensor or collision triggers, which technically enables event-driven automation, but there is no declarative or AI-native 'rule' definition system — it requires full plugin development in C++, not simple rule authoring. missing for 10: a no-code/declarative rule engine, event-trigger configuration UI or API accessible to non-developers, and any documentation framing this as an automation/rules feature rather than a plugin SDK.
